scope: Full adapter Python/C source review and bounded frozen-closure controls. No helper compilation, PostgreSQL launch, database connection/native effect, broad build, browser or installed qualification. G04 native recovery and initial generation remain open.
authority007: Independent accepted receipt preserved unchanged; native adapter review is separate. Actual real Ed25519 terminal-outcome bridge succeeds; adapter recovery adds an incorrect second hash.

actualChecks.independentProbes: probes.py/probes.stdout; real crypto original terminal success plus fresh supervisor recovery refusal, closed native and journal shapes, exact custody validator and source constructor correspondence

findings.title: Read the flat native database observation
findings.detail: observe_original_registration indexes native[database][systemIdentifier/oid], but _observe_native returns flat systemIdentifier/databaseOid. Genuine matching native observation raises KeyError(database).

findings.title: Resolve config/HBA pins from the matching launch intent
findings.detail: _native_origin_matches reads hbaDigest/configDigest from launch-confirmed, whose exact closed payload has only launchId/process/nativeObservationDigest/endpointReceiptDigest. A matching original launch reaches KeyError(hbaDigest), blocking registration and store continuity.

findings.title: Project store settings from the complete native observation
findings.detail: _native_store_preparation_payload passes complete _observe_native output to _store_required_settings, which requires exactly six keys. Every real complete observation is refused; keep exact six-field output and validate full session separately.

findings.title: Bind registration reservation to exact signed intent bytes
findings.detail: apply_target_registration uses outer profile umf.local-owner-target-registration/0.1 in reservation payload, while actual signed request is umf.owner-target-registration-intent/0.1. Recovery requires payloadDigest == request intent digest and necessarily refuses this original reservation.

findings.title: Preserve the fixed custody approval scope during recovery
findings.detail: reattach_original_registration reconstructs ownerApproval.scope=local-target-registration, whereas initial registration and actual ingress_custody wire validator require enroll-owned-local-postgresql-target. Exact original payload correspondence and custody registration reject recovery.

findings.title: Compare the stored receipt digest without hashing it again
findings.detail: Native adapter _digest hashes canonical JSON; owner_authority _digest validates an existing hex digest. Owner ledger stores outcome.receipt_digest unchanged. Recovery compares to a second hash at lines2027/2159/2690, refusing confirmed original effects. Real Ed25519 enrollment/signing/native resolver/terminal ledger probe confirms terminal success then fresh-supervisor recovery refusal; authority007 itself is not defective.

findings.title: Read the already-unwrapped registration event payload once
findings.detail: _resolve_original_store_preparation assigns registration_event from event[payload], then indexes registration_event[payload][payloadDigest]. Even after earlier continuity/settings fixes, valid retained evidence reaches KeyError(payload). Static source path finding; not exercised because preceding independent probes establish earlier blockers.

limitations: Deterministic fabricated native observations/journal exercise source semantics only.
